items: RAM and Storage - This Microsoft Surface Go 2 tablet features 8GB of LPDDR3 memory and a 128GB NVMe SSD, which dramatically improves multitasking speed and system response for file storage and software operation.

10.5in touch display - Elevate your computing with the Microsoft Surface Go 2 Touchscreen Tablet PC, featuring a 10-inch PixelSense display with a resolution of 1800x1200 pixels. The interactive touchscreen provides a dynamic and responsive interface, enhancing your overall user experience. Surface signature 3:2 ratio lets you see more, do more, and browse better with the most vertical screen real estate on a laptop.

Core M3-8100Y - his Surface GO 2 Touchscreen Tablet is powered by Intel Core M3-8100Y dual-core, quad-thread processor (Up to 3.4GHz), which balances performance and endurance to easily cope with office software, multitasking browsing, and light creative needs.

Connectivity and Tech Specs - his Microsoft tablet weighs just 522 grams and is 8.3mm thick, with a metal body that integrates an infinitely adjustable stand; it comes with USB-C 3.1, a Surface Connect charging port, and a 3.5mm headphone jack

Win 11 Pro System - This refurbished Surface GO 2 Tablet comes pre-installed with Windows 11 Pro operating system, which is seamlessly compatible with all kinds of software and applications, with powerful system features and security performance, providing you with a more stable and efficient using experience.
